finalText:
Dedupe added: 99 repeats dropped (the ~1-in-9 flaps that re-fire 2 minutes later). `createState()` now returns `{ lastSentAt: Map }` tracking the last delivery time per key.

Two judgment calls: the window is exclusive (`at - last < 5`, so a repeat exactly 5 minutes later goes through), and a quiet-hours `queue` delivery counts as "sent" for dedupe purposes.
